newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds ended little changed in a quiet market that was thinned by a local Zurich holiday.
Rising three month Eurofranc futures and lower Swiss franc swaps created a friendly environment during the day that helped Conf futures make gains. But Conf slipped back again shortly before close.

Swiss franc swaps also started firmer but then eased. Two-year swaps gave up three basis points to 2.27/37 percent. Five and ten-year swaps each gave up one point to 3.11/21 and 3.96/06, respectively.
Conf futures CONFc1 down five basis points at 118.44
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 down five at 111.00
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 up four at 98.07
